early_stopping.criterion: Strict improvement in mean internal-validation normalized squared error; test is not used

competing_workloads: Single GPU/framework owner; CPU FEM generation, downloads or extraction can run concurrently on this shared workstation.
normalization_note: Train cases only; scalar channels use one mean/std across nodes and time. DisplacementXYZ shares sqrt(trace(covariance)/3) as one vector field. Constant scalar channels use scale1. No label replacement or clipping. Equal normalized squared error weights per channel and time; all nodes uniformly weighted. Coordinates use train bounds with recorded1%input margin.
input_information: Initial coordinates, thickness, 2 global parameters; no target result is an input. Architecture adapters differ only in API/layout/graph use.
prediction_scope: One-shot all stored nonzero times. Evaluation cases already have FEM reference results; no novel appliance or geometry generalization is tested.
memory_note: RSS sampled at step/epoch boundaries; lower bound on true process peak. CUDA allocator peak measured by PyTorch, not total driver VRAM.
